solution_title: Photorealistic 3D Map Explorer, Camera Tour & 3D Trail Route
summary: Phase 2 Shared Solution Architecture Blueprint for a Photorealistic 3D Lake Tahoe Trail Explorer & Camera Tour application across all 8 web framework stacks. Uses the Maps JavaScript API maps3d library (Map3DElement / <gmp-map-3d> with mode SATELLITE or HYBRID and internalUsageAttributionIds=['gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0']), renders an extruded bright-red 3D hiking trail route (Polyline3DElement with strokeColor: 'rgb(255, 0, 0)', strokeWidth: 8, altitudeMode: 'RELATIVE_TO_GROUND', extruded: true), interactive 3D trailhead and viewpoint markers (Marker3DInteractiveElement with PinElement using glyphText and gmp-click listeners), smooth 3D camera storytelling animations (map3d.flyCameraTo adjusting center, tilt, heading, and range), live Elevation API path sampling for the interactive elevation profile chart and gain/loss metrics (ElevationService.getElevationAlongPath on client stacks; /api/elevation/profile BFF proxy on full-stack stacks), and live Places API (New) landmark search (PlaceAutocompleteElement listening to gmp-select + Place.searchByText for the initial seed search 'Emerald Bay State Park, Lake Tahoe'). Strictly enforces zero deprecated APIs, explicit non-zero map dimensions, and ToS/security compliance.
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (Photorealistic 3D Maps: Map3DElement, Polyline3DElement, Marker3DInteractiveElement, PopoverElement)
Elevation API (ElevationService.getElevationAlongPath & getElevationForLocations / Elevation REST API)
Map Tiles API (Photorealistic 3D Tiles rendered via maps3d)
seed_search_query: Emerald Bay State Park, Lake Tahoe
ui_layout_summary: Full-viewport dark-slate alpine explorer layout (100vh, min-height 600px, zero scrollbars on desktop). Top floating glassmorphic header bar houses the app title ('Lake Tahoe 3D Trail Explorer'), the Places landmark search bar (PlaceAutocompleteElement + fallback/BFF search input for full-stack parity), and live 3D camera telemetry readout (heading, tilt, range). Left floating sidebar (360px wide on desktop, collapsible bottom drawer on mobile) contains: (1) Guided Chapter Tour preset buttons ('1. Emerald Bay Overview', '2. Eagle Falls Trailhead', '3. Rubicon Ridge', '4. Eagle Point Overlook', '5. Tahoe Summit Panorama') plus an Auto-Play Tour toggle that executes smooth map3d.flyCameraTo() transitions; (2) Active Viewpoint / Searched Landmark detail card populated with live Places API (New) and Elevation API data; and (3) Interactive SVG Elevation Profile chart & trail metrics strip (total distance, min/max elevation, total ascent/descent) sampled live via Elevation API—hovering or clicking a chart sample highlights the corresponding elevation point and can pan/focus the 3D camera. Right/main canvas (flex-1, min-height: 520px, min-width: 300px) renders the full-bleed <gmp-map-3d> / Map3DElement with the extruded red RGB(255, 0, 0) 3D trail polyline and interactive 3D viewpoint markers.

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Server-side BFF proxy for Places API (New) Text Search to locate Lake Tahoe landmarks and viewpoints without exposing server keys or hitting browser CORS limits.
Server-side BFF proxy for Places API (New) Autocomplete suggestions to support landmark search on full-stack frameworks.
Server-side BFF proxy to sample equidistant elevation points along the Lake Tahoe hiking trail path and query point elevations for searched landmarks via the Elevation API.
